exposure: Transversus abdominis plane block (TAPB) with 8 mg dexamethasone and 0.375% ropivacaine (control)
TAPB with 0.5 mg/kg dexmedetomidine, 8 mg dexamethasone, and 0.375% ropivacaine
TAPB with 1 mg/kg dexmedetomidine, 8 mg dexamethasone, and 0.375% ropivacaine
outcome: Visual Analog Scale (VAS) scores for pain at rest
VAS scores for pain with movement
Incidence of moderate to severe pain
cohort: 90 patients scheduled for cesarean section were randomly assigned to one of three treatment groups.
finding: Adding dexmedetomidine to dexamethasone and ropivacaine for TAPB significantly improved post-cesarean dynamic pain conditions and reduced the incidence of moderate-to-severe dynamic pain, with the higher dose of dexmedetomidine (1 mg/kg) showing the lowest dynamic pain scores at 48 hours.
